steps.positions: Time for both hands at once. Put the right thumb on middle {c} and the left little finger on the {c} an octave below. Each hand covers five white keys.
steps.up: Go up with both hands: they play the same notes at the same time, an octave apart. The left hand starts with the little finger, the right hand with the thumb.
steps.together: Up and down in time with the metronome. Listen for both hands landing exactly together.
